# Zed Cafe Docs

> Guides for making worlds in Zed Cafe, plus architecture and developer reference for the Zed Software System.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://zed.cafe/docs): Zed Cafe docs -- guides for making worlds, plus the system reference for ZSS.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://zed.cafe/docs/guides): Step-by-step tutorials for making things in Zed Cafe, from your first visit to your first scripted object.
- [Your first ten minutes](https://zed.cafe/docs/guides/first-ten-minutes): Open zed.cafe, find your way around the `terminal`, load a starter kit, and look inside a book.
- [Your first board](https://zed.cafe/docs/guides/first-board): Build walls on the title board, connect a second room, then save and share the result.
- [Your first object](https://zed.cafe/docs/guides/first-object): Write ZSS code for a lamp, a switch, and a talking character, using stats, labels, flags, messages, `scroll` text, and links.

## Look up

- [Glossary](https://zed.cafe/docs/glossary): Shared Zed Cafe vocabulary — short definitions, cross-links, and where to read more.

### Firmware

- [Firmware](https://zed.cafe/docs/firmware): Firmware is the
- [Audio](https://zed.cafe/docs/firmware/audio)
- [Board](https://zed.cafe/docs/firmware/board)

- [Transforms](https://zed.cafe/docs/firmware/transforms)

### Synth

- [Synth](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth): Synth docs -- play commands, then internals (signal path and module maps).

#### Play

- [Synth](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/voices): Learn
- [Effects](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/effects): Learn voice FX sends — bus addressing, starter presets, and what each effect should sound like.
- [Notation](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/playnotation): How to write
- [Scales](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/scales): Play lines for major, minor, blues, modal, pentatonic, and exotic scales.

#### Internals

- [Matrix](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/implementation-matrix): Daisy voice, FX, drum, and main-chain implementation map.
- [Main chain](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/audiochain): Play, drums, TTS, sidechain, compressor, and razzle into the output.
- [FX bus](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/parallel-fx-bus): Parallel voice FX send/return law in Daisy.
- [Gain levels](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/gain-levels): Every tweakable volume/gain stage in the live Daisy synth path.
- [Drums](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/drums): Kit IDs and how drum triggers map into the Daisy path.
- [Recording](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/record-and-mp3): Offline
- [Factory](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/factory): setupsynth / createsynth entry (`zss/feature/synth/index.ts`).
- [Sources](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/source): SOURCE_TYPE enum and source factory (`source.ts`).
- [Source wiring](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/sourcefxsetup): 8 voices into 4 FX groups (`sourcefxsetup.ts`).
- [FX modules](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/fx-and-fxchannels): Shared FX chain and per-voice sends (`fx.ts`, `fxchannels.ts`).
- [Note ticks](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/tickhandler): Scheduled note and drum events (`tickhandler.ts`).
- [Algo FM](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/algosynth): 4-op FM routings for algo0–algo7 (`algosynth.ts` / Daisy algovoice).
- [Worklets](https://zed.cafe/docs/synth/worklets): Frequency crusher and sidechain AudioWorklet processors.
